text:
As at night sings

the esquirina


to the esquirín

who is on another

branch


"esquirín,

if you want me to go, I will go

if you want me to go, I will go;"

and to her branch the esquirín

calls her:


Esquirina,

If you want to come,

come


If you want to come,

come,"


and when she

goes where he is


the esquirín goes

to another branch:


that is how I call

to you,


and you go away


That is how I call to you,


and you go away.

translation.title: As at Night Sings
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bird-call structure and the repeated withdrawal after the beloved is called.
